page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 vCPUs mapped across 4 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, running on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU features 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. It includes instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and BMI2.

The instance is provisioned with 32.0 GB of memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

In synthetic benchmarks, the ecs.g5.2xlarge shows modest compute capabilities, with Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores reaching 1006.0 and 3857.0 respectively, placing it in the lower quartile of modern compute instances. Memory throughput exhibits average results during large block transfers at 40.9 GB/sec read and 35.94 GB/sec write, but registers lower performance on smaller, cached transactions. While lightweight LLM prompt processing on a 135M model achieves an average 456.64 tokens/sec, medium 7B model execution falls into the bottom tier at 5.29 tokens/sec for generation.

Given its balanced resource profile and lack of local NVMe storage, this server type is suitable for balanced general-purpose workloads, standard web application serving, backend microservices, and development environments that do not require high single-threaded throughput or hardware-accelerated processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 32.0 GB of memory, it delivers a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. The instance includes AVX-512 extensions and a 35 MB L3 cache, but contains zero bundled local storage and no GPU accelerators. Baseline network throughput is rated at 2 Gbps. Synthetic benchmarks reveal entry-to-mid-tier performance, characterized by 1006.0 Geekbench single-core and 3857.0 multi-core scores, alongside 40.9 GB/sec uncached read bandwidth. Resource efficiency is balanced for standard system architectures rather than raw compute density. The ecs.g5.2xlarge is best suited for general application hosting, basic web servers, non-critical enterprise services, and development or staging environments requiring consistent baseline resources without demanding extreme computational speed.
